data.question: Which historical firms and named public personnel form the TSC contractor lineage preceding BAE's 2025 Analysis Services award?
data.method: GAO decision review, DOJ forecast review, historical notice comparison, company announcement review and strict requirement-scope separation.
data.scope: Public TSC procurement and contractor records from 2014 through 2025.
findings: SAVA and Sotera were publicly described as existing TSC support contractors during the 2014 operational/IT consolidation.
STOPSO won the 2014 operational-support competition and Lynxnet was an unsuccessful offeror and protester.
Koniag won a 2019 TSC critical-facilities task order and INTELiTEAMS was an offeror and protester.
Cyberspace Solutions publicly identified itself as BAE's analytic-support teammate on a 2020 TSC program.
Lafayette Mabry, Jerry Mannes II and James Nowotny are public professional-personnel leads with different, bounded roles.
None of these historical records identifies the six unsuccessful 2025 offerors or any FBI-TSC-AIE respondent.
conclusions: Treat the historical roster as a cross-match set, not as a current bidder list.
Use the official-source collector to recover archived notices, forecasts, awardee lists and industry-registration records.
Require direct source-selection or response evidence before assigning 2025 offeror or 2026 AI-RFI status.
limitations: The SAVA/Sotera bridge evidence currently relies on a mirror of a historical SAM.gov notice.
The 2025 source-selection and subcontract records remain unavailable.
James Nowotny's exact historical employment chain is based on secondary career announcements.
unresolved: Six unsuccessful 2025 TSC Analysis Services offerors.
Current BAE subcontractors and key personnel.
Every FBI-TSC-AIE respondent and briefing participant.
Official archived copy of the SAVA bridge notice.

data.research_question: What historical TSC contractor lineage can be established before resolving the 2025 seven-offeror roster?
data.method: Official decision and forecast review with historical notice and company-announcement comparison.
classification_rules: Historical incumbency is not current offeror status.
A protest representative is not automatically proposal or program leadership.
Operational, IT, facilities, analytic and AI-enhancement requirements remain separate.
A 2020 teammate is not assumed to remain a 2025 subcontractor.

findings.finding: STOPSO and Lynxnet had confirmed opposing roles in the 2014 TSC operational-support procurement.
Koniag and INTELiTEAMS had confirmed opposing roles in the 2019 TSC critical-facilities procurement.
Cyberspace Solutions publicly announced a 2020 BAE TSC teammate role.
Any historical contractor is one of the six unsuccessful 2025 offerors.

data.next_action: Run the official-source collector and obtain 2025 offeror, subcontract and 2026 RFI response records.
